def _resist_tp(self, s, lo_price):
        """Ближайшее сопротивление не ниже lo_price: край скопления на продажу или pivot-максимум. Возвращает цену тейка (на тик ниже)."""
        asks = s["asks_snap"]
        if not asks:
            return None
        tick, cand = self._tick(asks), []
        if len(asks) >= 50:
            cand += [cl["near"] - tick for cl in self.clus_list(asks, "ask")]
        for d in self.ctx.get(s["name"], {}).values():
            cand += [p - tick for p in d["ph"]]
        ok = [x for x in cand if x >= lo_price]
        return min(ok) if ok else None

    def _support_stop(self, s, bid, cur_stop):
        """Стоп под ближайшей поддержкой (низ скопления bid или pivot-минимум, минус запас). Никогда не ниже текущего стопа."""
        c, buf, cand = self.c, self.c["STOP_BELOW_BPS"] / 1e4, []
        bs = s["bids_snap"]
        if len(bs) >= 50:
            cand += [cl["far"] * (1 - buf) for cl in self.clus_list(bs, "bid")]
        for d in self.ctx.get(s["name"], {}).values():
            cand += [p * (1 - buf) for p in d["pl"]]
        ok = [x for x in cand if cur_stop < x <= bid * (1 - c["MIN_STOP_GAP_BPS"] / 1e4)]
        return max(ok) if ok else None

    def _place_tp(self, s, now):
        c, p = self.c, s["pos"]
        asks = s["asks_snap"]
        if not asks or now - s["snap_t"] > 30:
            p["need_tp"], p["tp_try"] = True, now
            return False
        ask = s["asks"][0][0] if s["asks"] else asks[0][0]
        lo_price = max(ask * (1 + c["MIN_TP_GAP_BPS"] / 1e4), p["last_tp"] * (1 + 3e-4))
        if c["TP_MODE"] == "percent":                              # тейки на фиксированных процентах прибыли от входа
            tp = max(p["entry"] * (1 + c["TP%d_PCT" % (min(p["ntp"], 2) + 1)] / 100.0), lo_price)
        else:
            tp = self._resist_tp(s, lo_price)
        if tp is None:
            p["need_tp"], p["tp_try"] = True, now
            return False
        tick = self._tick(asks)
        tp = round(round(tp / tick) * tick, 10)
        qty = p["qty"] if p["n_left"] == 1 else min(p["qty"], p["qty0"] * c["TRANCHE"])
        s["order"] = dict(side="sell", price=tp, qty=qty, t_place=now, t_act=now + c["LATENCY"], queue=None)
        p["tp_qty"], p["last_tp"], p["need_tp"] = qty, tp, False
        self.log(now, s["name"], "tp_order", tp, "часть %d из 4" % (4 - p["n_left"] + 1))
        return True

    def _partial(self, s, qty, px, why, now):
        """Закрыть часть позиции. True, если позиция закрыта полностью."""
        p = s["pos"]
        qty = min(qty, p["qty"])
        p["parts"].append([qty, px, why, round(now - p["t"], 1)])
        p["qty"] -= qty
        p["n_left"] -= 1
        p["be"] = self._be_price(p)
        if why == "be" and p["be"]:
            p["stop"] = max(p["stop"], p["be"] * (1 + self.c["BE_SLIP_BPS"] / 1e4))
        self.log(now, s["name"], "part_" + why, px, "закрыто %.0f%%" % (100 * (1 - p["qty"] / p["qty0"])))
        if p["qty"] <= p["qty0"] * 1e-9 or p["n_left"] <= 0:
            if p["qty"] > p["qty0"] * 1e-9:
                p["parts"].append([p["qty"], px, why, round(now - p["t"], 1)])
                p["qty"] = 0.0
            self._final(s, now)
            return True
        return False

    def _final(self, s, now):
        c, p = self.c, s["pos"]
        parts, e = p["parts"], p["entry"]
        invest = e * p["qty0"]
        sold = sum(q for q, *_ in parts)
        gross_usd = sum(q * (px - e) for q, px, _, _ in parts)
        fee_usd = c["FEE"] * (invest + sum(q * px for q, px, _, _ in parts))
        net_usd = gross_usd - fee_usd
        exit_px = sum(q * px for q, px, _, _ in parts) / sold
        lo, hi = (p["lo"] / e - 1) * 100, (p["hi"] / e - 1) * 100
        why = "+".join(x[2] for x in parts)
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO trades(ts_open,ts_close,symbol,entry,exit,qty,exit_type,gross_pct,fee_pct,net_pct,net_usdt,hold_sec,obi,spread_bps,"
                        "lo_pct,hi_pct,lo_usd,hi_usd,lo_sec,hi_sec,parts,ref,cfg) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (p["t"], now, s["name"], e, exit_px, p["qty0"], why, gross_usd / invest, fee_usd / invest, net_usd / invest,
                         net_usd, now - p["t"], p["obi"], p["spr"], lo, hi, lo / 100 * invest, hi / 100 * invest,
                         p["lo_t"], p["hi_t"], json.dumps(parts), json.dumps(p.get("ref")), p.get("cfg")))
        self.db.commit()
        self.log(now, s["name"], "exit_" + parts[-1][2], parts[-1][1], "net=%.3f%% (%s)" % (net_usd / invest * 100, why))
        s["pos"], s["order"], s["mkt"], s["pm"] = None, None, None, None
        s["cool"] = now + c["COOLDOWN"]

    def _close(self, s, px, why, now):
        p = s["pos"]
        if why == "tp":                               # исполнился лимитный тейк на часть позиции
            qty = p["tp_qty"] or p["qty"]
            p["tp_qty"] = 0
            p["ntp"] += 1
            if self._partial(s, qty, px, "t%d" % p["ntp"], now):
                return
            bid = s["bids"][0][0] if s["bids"] else px
            ns = self._support_stop(s, bid, p["stop"])
            if ns:
                p["stop"] = ns
                self.log(now, s["name"], "stop_move", ns, "под поддержку")
            self._place_tp(s, now)
            return
        p["parts"].append([p["qty"], px, why, round(now - p["t"], 1)])   # стоп или timeout: закрываем остаток
        p["qty"] = 0.0
        self._final(s, now)

    def _manage(self, s, now):
        c, p = self.c, s["pos"]
        bid = s["bids"][0][0]
        if bid < p["lo"]:
            p["lo"], p["lo_t"] = bid, now - p["t"]
        if bid > p["hi"]:
            p["hi"], p["hi_t"] = bid, now - p["t"]
        pm = s["pm"]
        if pm and now >= pm["t"] and not s["mkt"]:      # часть позиции по рынку (безубыток)
            s["pm"] = None
            if self._partial(s, pm["qty"], self._walk(s["bids"], pm["qty"]), pm["why"], now):
                return
            p = s["pos"]
        if s["mkt"]:
            return super()._manage(s, now)              # исполнение рыночного выхода остатка
        lim = c["HOLD_SEC"] if p["stage"] == 0 else c["HOLD_AFTER_BE_SEC"]      # после безубытка timeout снят
        why = "stop" if bid <= p["stop"] else ("timeout" if lim and now - p["t"] >= lim else None)
        if why:
            s["order"], s["pm"] = None, None
            s["mkt"] = dict(t=now + c["LATENCY"], why=why)
            self.log(now, s["name"], why, bid, "")
            return
        if p["stage"] >= 1:                                                     # трейлинг-стоп
            p["peak"] = max(p.get("peak", bid), bid)
            p["stop"] = max(p["stop"], p["peak"] * (1 - c["TRAIL_BPS"] / 1e4))
        if p["stage"] == 0 and bid >= p["entry"] * (1 + c["BE_TRIGGER_BPS"] / 1e4):
            p["stage"] = 1
            q = p["qty0"] * c["TRANCHE"]
            p["stop"] = max(p["stop"], self._be_price(p, extra=(q, bid)) * (1 + c["BE_SLIP_BPS"] / 1e4))
            s["pm"] = dict(t=now + c["LATENCY"], qty=q, why="be")
            self.log(now, s["name"], "be_trigger", bid, "стоп в безубыток %.8g" % p["stop"])
            self._place_tp(s, now)
            return
        if p["stage"] >= 1 and p["need_tp"] and not s["order"] and now - p["tp_try"] >= 15:
            self._place_tp(s, now)
